title: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Learned Retrieval Necessity
abstract: We propose a method that extends self-reflective retrieval by learning when retrieval is necessary during generation. Unlike Self-RAG which uses fixed reflection tokens, our approach uses a lightweight classifier trained on the generator's internal uncertainty to trigger retrieval only when the model's confidence drops below a dynamic threshold. We combine this with iterative retrieval, allowing multiple retrieval rounds within a single generation pass. Experiments on Natural Questions and TriviaQA show improvements over Self-RAG and CRAG baselines.
